scope: Unmerged ninth ordered FreeCAD default DXF importer patch: bounded POLYFACE and polygon meshes with parent ACI color.
base: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e with eight preceding ordered importer patches, including mandatory block-layer correction.
change: Admit one parent group 62 ACI value 1–255 or explicit BYLAYER 256 for bounded meshes; preserve it through existing common attributes. Reject duplicates, malformed, negative, out-of-range and BYBLOCK values. With color preservation enabled, refuse explicit ACI mesh colors in block definitions because fused block composition drops child colors. Per-face styles remain refused.
baseline: Generated parent-color POLYFACE and polygon-mesh controls were refused by the preceding importer.

validation.focused: Seven FreeCAD importer tests pass on macOS ARM64. Direct tests cover both mesh types, admitted and rejected ACI values, following LINE and recovery after duplicate color; block tests cover both mesh types, color-preservation on/off, explicit/BYLAYER and no leaked faces. Existing layer and bounded mesh regression controls pass.
validation.fusedGrouping: For two generated meshes, differing ACI colors create two groups when colors are preserved; identical colors or disabled color preservation create one group. Total area remains 12 square millimetres.
validation.peer: The originally tested ezdxf files had explicit parent colors but omitted child/face group 62, which defaults to BYLAYER. They demonstrate only the old importer grouping and do not establish source-color fidelity. Corrected ezdxf files with matching parent, vertex and face colors pass the same grouping controls after the mandatory consistency correction.
validation.replay: Zero-context patch applies with git apply --unidiff-zero after the preceding eight patches; all four source files and test file match the tested candidate.

limits: Only headless grouping and geometry are verified; GUI appearance, native Draft, other platforms and native producer semantics remain open.
Block explicit colors are refused when preserving colors; face-specific styles, BYBLOCK, truecolor, hidden edges, smoothing and nonplanar faces remain unsupported.
No drawing fixture is committed; no phase gate or external-only support claim is promoted.
The parent-color patch must be followed by freecad-p8-default-mesh-color-consistency-2026-11-16.patch. Do not treat its original parent-only color profiles as semantic evidence.
